_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: 12h coil (score ±2 in only 3% of windows) plus equal-weight factors still inside 32-38 keep the phase pinned; tactical SHORT is a price-level call, not a rung relocation.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst forward HOLD-phase + tactical SHORT; narrative reads accumulation-bottom constructive
next_move.confirmed_if: Score stays 32-38, BTC fails 24h reclaim, fear_greed <=35, funding not deeply negative
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G <15 + funding negative + 30d mom collapse (into Panic) OR squeeze lifts F&G >40 with ETF flows reversing (into Anxiety)
